name: @ocs/format
//: Formats and file containers: URL, HTML entities, JWT, JSON, XML, case, UUID, password, random values and OpenPGP. Implementations use mature libraries where one exists. `./manifests` is eager and dependency-free; `./definition` is the on-demand family half, and OpenPGP.js is behind a second literal dynamic import so selecting another format tool does not load it.
